proposed_contract.transcendental_primitives: Correctly rounded binary64 results from the version-pinned owned adapter; binary32 pow uses direct binary32 rounding.
proposed_contract.composition: Preserve the declared binary64 or binary32 operation sequence between calls. A composition is not claimed to equal one rounding of a real-arithmetic whole operation.
proposed_contract.integer_power: Fixed repeated-squaring sequence followed by a reciprocal for negative exponents. Intermediate overflow and compiler-folding differences require separate migration evidence.
proposed_contract.special_values: NaN signs/payloads, signed zeros, infinities, domain results and formatted text require explicit per-function policy and independent controls. Finite rounding certificates do not establish this policy.
proposed_contract.extended_arithmetic: Existing extended-precision paths retain their precision and order.
proposed_contract.cpu_support: Do not raise the minimum supported CPU instruction set to obtain passing results.
